assets.prompt: Use case: product-mockup. Production texture asset for the INSIDE of a small handcrafted cream desktop terminal, a 100mm square circuit board. Render one single perfectly square flat PCB texture, orthographic face-on, camera exactly perpendicular, zero perspective, board edges coincident with image edges. Rounded corners radius 3 percent. Realistic dark muted forest green FR4 solder mask with copper traces, fine gold vias, realistic solder joints and extremely subtle brushed material grain. This must look like a photographed manufactured PCB, not vector art or a stylized illustration. Physically plausible modest custom electronics, sparse and purposeful. Components: one central black QFP microcontroller at x47%, y34% with fine realistic silver gull-wing leads; a few small SMD resistors and capacitors toward upper left and right; a small flat cream FFC ribbon connector centered at x50%, y9%; four gold screw mounting holes at (7%,7%), (93%,7%), (7%,93%), (93%,93%). CRITICAL: exactly three identical mechanical keyboard switch sockets, centers at (17%,82%),(50%,82%),(83%,82%). Their square black housings are 17% of board width, each with a modest beige cross-shaped stem. No keycaps, screen, enclosure, backdrop, scene, cables coming out, hands, logos or large text. Fine unobtrusive tiny silkscreen component IDs only. Lighting: warm softbox from upper left, soft dark contact shadows tight to components, gentle overall warm rosy environmental tint, restrained highlights, realistic roughness. No dramatic shine, no neon. Fill whole square with the board. High-end macro product photography with all components in focus. This will be mapped onto an existing exact board plane and must not contain any perspective or a scene around the board.
